title: Dual-Commodity Welcome on Residential Electricity Supply Sign-Up Credits
content:
**Rule.** When a Beacon Ridge gas agreement under Residential Natural Gas Supply on the same premise as the Residential Electricity Supply agreement is active and the customer's gas bill lines already carry a gas sign-up credit, the settled dual-commodity welcome of 15.00 USD is added to the sign-up credit; when such a gas agreement is active and no gas sign-up credit has been posted, the new dual-commodity welcome of 10.00 USD is added; when no gas agreement on the premise is active, nothing is added.

**Records read.** The status of the gas agreement at the same premise, and whether any sign-up credit line appears among the customer's Residential Natural Gas Supply bill lines.

| Gas agreement on the premise | Gas sign-up credit already on the customer's gas bills | Dual-commodity welcome |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | 15.00 USD |
| active | no | 10.00 USD |
| not active, or none | any | nothing |
